# Rakibul Labs — Full Context

## Entity
Rakibul Labs is an independent AI studio founded by Rakibul Islam. The studio's official website is https://rakibul-labs.vercel.app/. It builds AI products, self-hosted LLM stacks, and high-performance web apps.

## Founder
- Name: Rakibul Islam
- Role: Founder of Rakibul Labs & Co-Owner of CyberSAVVY SMMA
- Location: Barpeta, Assam, India
- Email: rakibulwspace@gmail.com
- Primary website: https://rakibul-labs.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/rakibuilds

## Purpose and focus
Rakibul Labs focuses on AI-first development, self-hosted infrastructure, local model execution, and tools that prioritize user privacy and performance over cloud dependency. The goal is to build useful, private, and fast software.

## Related work and projects
- **Rakibul AI Labs** — A personal R&D sandbox for local LLMs, custom agentic workflows, and self-hosted AI stacks. It is hosted at https://rakibuilds.github.io/.
- **CyberSAVVY SMMA** — A local SEO and digital marketing agency co-owned by Rakibul Islam. It combines AI data pipelines with human strategy: https://cybersavvysmma.com/.
- **Writing** — Essays on AI, engineering, and building online: https://substack.com/@rakibulia and https://rakibulia.medium.com/.

## Topics
Local large language models (LLMs), self-hosted inference, agentic workflows, Next.js, Python, open-source software, AI experiments, digital marketing, and web projects.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Rakibul Labs?
It is the independent AI studio founded by Rakibul Islam, focusing on AI products, agentic workflows, and high-performance web systems.

### What is Rakibul AI Labs?
It is a separate R&D project by Rakibul Islam, acting as a sandbox for local LLMs, self-hosted AI stacks, and AI experiments. It is hosted at https://rakibuilds.github.io/.

### Who is the founder?
Rakibul Islam is the Founder of Rakibul Labs and Co-Owner of CyberSAVVY SMMA, based in Barpeta, Assam, India.

### What does the studio build?
Custom AI tools, self-hosted LLM setups, agentic workflows, and Next.js web applications.
